verses.sanskrit:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच।
              अस्मानभिगतांस्तात भयार्ताञ्छरणैषिणः। कौरवान् विषमप्राप्तान् कथं ब्रूयास्त्वमीदृशम्॥१॥
verses.english: Yudhishthira said : O child, why do you speak these cruel words to these frightened Kurus who are now in adversity and who have come to us for protection?
verses.bhavadeepa: अपस्वरं क्रोधेन विकलवर्णं यथा स्यात् तथा ब्रुवाणम् ॥२२॥

verses.sanskrit: भवन्ति भेदा ज्ञातीनां कलहाश्च वृकोदर। प्रसक्तानि च वैराणि कुलधर्मो न नश्यति॥२॥
verses.english: O Vrikodara, dissensions and disputes often take place among those that are connected in blood. Such hostilities always exist, but for it family honour is never suffered to be destroyed.

verses.sanskrit: यदा तु कश्चिज्ज्ञातीनां बाह्यः प्रार्थयते कुलम्। न मर्षयन्ति तत् सन्तो बाह्येनाभिप्रधर्षणम्॥३॥
verses.english: If any stranger seeks to destroy the honour of a family, they that are good never tolerate such insult to be offered by the stranger.

verses.sanskrit: जानात्येष हि दुर्बुद्धिरस्मानिह चिरोषितान्। स एवं परिभूयास्मानकार्षीदिदमप्रियम्॥४॥
verses.english: The wretched minded one (Gandharva king) knows that we are living here for some time. (Even knowing this), he has disregarded us and has done this which is disagreeable to us.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्योधनस्य ग्रहणाद्गन्धर्वेण बलात् प्रभो। स्त्रीणां वाह्याभिमर्शाच्च हतं भवति नः कुलम्॥५॥
verses.english: O exalted one, from this forcible seizure of Duryodhana and from this insult offered to the ladies of our family by a stranger, our family honour is destroyed,

verses.sanskrit: शरणं च प्रपन्नानां त्राणार्थं च कुलस्य च। उत्तिष्ठध्वं नरव्याघ्राः सज्जीभवत मा चिरम्॥६॥
verses.english: O foremost of men, arise and arm yourselves without the least delay to rescue those that have sought protection and also to save the honour of our family.

verses.sanskrit: अर्जुनश्च यमौ चैव त्वं च वीरापराजितः। मोक्षयध्वं नरव्याघ्रा ह्रियमाणं सुयोधनम्॥७॥
verses.english: Let Arjuna and the twins (Nakula and Sahadeva) and yourself and also those that are brave and invincible (at once go and) rescue Duryodhana who is even now being taken away as a prisoner.

verses.sanskrit: एते रथा नरव्याघ्राः सर्वशस्त्रसमन्विताः। धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्राणां विमलाः काञ्चनध्वजाः॥८॥
verses.english: These blazing cars with golden flag-staffs belonging to the son of Dhritarashtra are now all ready (before you). With Indrasena and other charioteers who are all skilled in arms, ride all of you these ever furnished cars with deep rattling noise. Ride on them and fight to your utmost power with the Gandharvas to rescue Duryodhana. Even an ordinary Kshatriya would try his best to protect one who has come to him for protection. What then, O Vrikodara, shall I speak to you?

verses.sanskrit: सस्वनानधिरोहध्वं नित्यसज्जानिमान् रथान्। इन्द्रसेनादिभिः सूतैः कृतशस्त्रैरधिष्ठितान्॥९॥
एतानास्थाय वै यत्ता गन्धर्वान् योद्धुमाहवे। सुयोधनस्य मोक्षाय प्रयतध्वमतन्द्रिताः॥१०॥
य एव कश्चिद्राजन्यः शरणार्थमिहागतम्। परं शक्त्याऽभिरक्षेत किम्पुनस्त्वं वृकोदर॥११॥
क इहार्यो भवेत् त्राणमभिधावेति चोदितः। प्राञ्जलिं शरणापन्नं दृष्ट्वा शत्रुमपि ध्रुवम्॥१२॥
verses.english: Entreated for assistance in such words as these, “O hasten to my help,” who is there that is so mean as not to help even his enemy when he see him to crave for protection with joined hands? The bestowal of a boon, a sovereignty and the birth of a son are sources of great happiness. But to rescue an enemy from distress is equal to all three.

verses.sanskrit: वरप्रदानं राज्यं च पुत्रजन्म च पाण्डवाः। शत्रोश्च मोक्षणं क्लेशान्त्रीणि चैकं च तत्समम्॥१३॥
verses.bhavadeepa: अभिधाव याहीति चोदित आर्यः त्राणं रक्षकः शरणागतस्य कः भवेत् । य आर्यो महान् स एव भवेत् । शरणागतरक्षणसमर्थो दुर्लभ इति भावः ॥१२॥

verses.sanskrit: किं चाप्यधिकमेतस्माद्यदापन्नः सुयोधनः। त्वद्बाहुबलमाश्रित्य जीवितं परिमार्गते॥१४॥
verses.english: What could be greater joy to you than that Duryodhana now in distress seeks his very life which now depends on the strength of your arms?

verses.sanskrit: स्वयमेव प्रधावेयं यदि न स्याद्वृकोदर। विततो मे क्रतुर्वीर न हि मेऽत्र विचारणा॥१५॥
verses.english: O Vrikodara, O hero, if the vow which I am engaged in observing were over, I would have certainly myself run to his assistance.

verses.sanskrit: साम्नैव तु यथा भीम मोक्षयेथाः सुयोधनम्। तथा सर्वैरुपायैस्त्वं यतेथाः कुरुनन्दन॥१६॥
verses.english: Try by all means, O Bhima, O Kuru prince, to rescue Duryodhana (first) by the act of conciliation. If however the Gandharva king cannot be managed by the act of conciliation, then you must try to rescue Duryodhana by light fighting.

verses.sanskrit: न साम्ना प्रतिपद्येत यदि गन्धर्वराडसौ। पराक्रमेण मृदुना मोक्षयेथाः सुयोधनम्॥१७॥
अथासौ मृदुयुद्धेन न मुञ्चेद्भीम कौरवान्। सर्वोपायैर्विमोच्यास्ते निगृह्य परिपन्थिनः॥१८॥
verses.english: If the Gandharvas do not let off the Kurus, even then, O Bhima, you must then rescue them by crushing the enemy by all means.

verses.sanskrit: एतावद्धि मया शक्यं सन्देष्टुं वै वृकोदर। वैताने कर्मणि तते वर्तमाने च भारत॥१९॥
verses.english: O Vrikodara, all this I can tell you now, for my vow has begun, but it has not ended as yet."

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              अजातशत्रोर्वचनं तच्छ्रुत्वा तु धनञ्जयः। प्रतिजज्ञे गुरोर्वाक्यं कौरवाणां विमोक्षणम्॥२०॥
verses.english: Having heard these words of Ajatshatru, Dhananjaya (Arjuna) at the command of his Guru, vowed to rescue the Kurus.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच।
              यदि साम्ना न मोक्ष्यन्ति गन्धर्वा धृतराष्ट्रजान्। अद्य गन्धर्वराजस्य भूमिः पास्यति शोर्णितम्॥२१॥
verses.english: “If the Gandharvas do not peacefully let off the Dhritarashtra people, the earth shall this day drink the blood of the Gandharvas." Hearing the vow of the truthful Arjuna, O king, the Kurus were fully cheered up.

verses.sanskrit: अर्जुनस्य तु तां श्रुत्वा प्रतिज्ञां सत्यवादिनः। कौरवाणां तदा राजन् पुनः प्रत्यागतं मनः॥२२॥
